package claim

// hold implements the "claim stays reserved for the tenant's next session"
// rule.
func hold() {}

// release follows "Claim hold and release rules" and the "Reserved hold" label.
func release() {}

// refuse: the gateway refuses a claim from any other tenant while the hold
// is in force, so a second tenant waits.
func refuse() {}

// expire ends the hold when its timer fires, and a "short quoted value"
// is a value rather than a quotation.
func expire() {}
